items.name: Yellow Corn - Truckload
items.description: US No. 2 yellow corn from Minnesota farms. Sold by the truckload (about 1,000 bushels). Moisture is 15% or less. Price is per bushel and based on that day's market price; we confirm it when you order. We deliver anywhere in Minnesota within 5 business days, or you can pick it up from us. Each load comes with a weight ticket. If a load doesn't meet the grade, tell us within 48 hours and we'll replace it or lower the price.

items.name: Yellow Corn - Future Delivery
items.description: The same US No. 2 yellow corn, delivered in a future month you pick (up to 6 months out). Minimum order is 5 truckloads. We lock in the price when you order, so it won't change before delivery. Same delivery, weight ticket and quality guarantee as our truckload option.
